title: Sino-Vietnamese War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Sino-Vietnamese War", at revision 1375848359, opens: "The Sino-Vietnamese War was a war which occurred in early 1979 between China and Vietnam. China launched an offensive ostensibly in response to Vietnam's invasion and occupation of Cambodia in 1978, which ended the rule of the Khmer Rouge. The conflict lasted for about a month, with China withdrawing its troops in March 1979." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q623171, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "war between the People's Republic of China and Socialist Republic of Vietnam in 1979". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
